hotspot: Runtime workbench scene is still DOM/SVG, not real canvas
evidence: CanvasWorkbench.razor:121-126 hosts a div; canvasWorkbenchInterop.js:6018-6121 builds div/svg layers; real canvas appears only in export path at canvasWorkbenchInterop.js:6254-6290.
impact: High DOM count, layout/reflow cost, SVG path churn, limited dense-scene headroom.

hotspot: Move flow still triggers full ReloadSurfaceAsync
evidence: ProjectStructurePage.razor:952-965 batches persistence correctly but still calls ReloadSurfaceAsync after move.
impact: Dense graphs pay unnecessary full graph reload and rebuild cost after every drag commit.

hotspot: View-state persistence remains on the hot path
evidence: ProjectStructurePage.razor:968-995, 1316-1330, 1426-1440 eagerly save state; PromptFactoryPage.razor:2867-2898 does the same.
impact: InteractiveServer chatter, extra DB writes, surface refresh churn, latency spikes.

evidence: canvasWorkbenchInterop.js:3038-3041 overlay selector does not cover floating windows/toolbox; wheel handler at 5880-5883 always zooms.
impact: Broken toolbox expand/collapse and accidental canvas zoom while using overlays.

hotspot: Toolbox behavior and layout are incomplete
evidence: ProjectStructurePage.razor:160-170 renders two-line rows with no tooltip; ProjectStructurePage.ToolWindows.cs:83-91 cannot toggle closed on second click; Playwright coverage misses true accordion behavior.
impact: Broken authoring flow and poor usability on a primary surface.

evidence: One file owns normalization, renderers, input, context menu, export, and bootstrap.
impact: Hard maintenance, review risk, helper duplication, hard-to-localize regressions.

evidence: Shared scene styles, toolbox, floating windows, diagnostics, and component-specific rules live together.
impact: Styling drift and unclear ownership boundaries.

hotspot: ProjectStructurePage markup and CSS remain extremely large
evidence: ProjectStructurePage.razor is 1808 lines and ProjectStructurePage.razor.css is 823 lines even after previous bundle work.
impact: Difficult to reason about page-specific features and regressions.

hotspot: App asset includes are duplicated and manual
evidence: Web App.razor:25-70 and Sandbox App.razor:17-56 each hard-code long CanvasLib script lists.
impact: Drift risk, missing script regressions, and extra maintenance cost.

hotspot: Preview-boundary components are mixed conceptually with runtime renderer code
evidence: Tiny boundary JS shims exist in CanvasLib and are loaded globally; PromptFactory support lane uses several preview components while runtime workbench uses different code paths.
impact: Confusion about what is runtime versus preview/demo support.

hotspot: PromptFactory is a second shared-canvas consumer with its own hot-path persistence issues
evidence: PromptFactoryPage.razor:2867-2898 eagerly persists UI state and refreshes the surface on shared callbacks.
impact: Shared-canvas refactors can regress PromptFactory or leave its performance path behind.

hotspot: Legacy real-canvas ProjectStructureCanvas exists but is disconnected from the current runtime
evidence: ProjectStructureCanvas.razor and workbenchInterop.js use real canvas but ProjectStructurePage now uses CanvasWorkbench.
impact: Useful reference implementation, but also architectural confusion if left undocumented.

hotspot: CanvasBenchmark exists but is not yet the authoritative migration evidence harness
evidence: CanvasBenchmark.razor already compares retained preview and true-canvas prototype, but no rollout gate consumes it.
impact: Renderer decisions risk being intuition-driven rather than measured.

hotspot: Export pipeline still assumes DOM clone instead of renderer-owned composition
evidence: CanvasWorkbench.CaptureImageAsync delegates to exportImageData; current export path clones workbench DOM and paints through foreignObject/canvas.
impact: Export will become fragile or misleading once runtime scene layers move to real canvas unless rewritten.
